title: Keep your phone up to date

cards.text: CISA says many updates fix security risks. Install updates for your phone and its apps as soon as you can.
cards.line: A quick update can close a weak spot.

cards.text: Turn on automatic updates in device or app settings. CISA says this lets updates install on their own.
cards.line: Let your phone handle the routine work.

cards.text: Updates cover the phone system, programs, and apps. CISA says web browsers and safety tools need updates too.
cards.line: Keep every part of the phone current.

checks.prompt: Why does CISA say updates matter?
options: They make the phone ring louder
checks.why: CISA says many updates fix risks.

checks.prompt: What setting can make updates easier?
options: Check for updates by hand each time
A larger font on every screen
checks.why: CISA says let updates run by themselves.

options: Only the apps you use most
The phone system, browser, and apps
checks.answer: The phone system, browser, and apps
checks.why: CISA says to update phone systems, browsers, and apps.

takeaway: Update your phone and apps. Let updates run on their own.
